title: anil baileyi
intro: Anil baileyi, commonly known as Andrographis baileyi or Himalayan Kalmegh, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Anil baileyi include reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting the body's natural defenses against infections. The bioactive constituents of Anil baileyi include andrographolide, andrographis neoadjunvate, and andrographolide-14-acetate, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
